question: Can optimization improve on DIM once target sufficiency is a non-tradeable constraint and KL/noise act only inside the feasible region?
novelty: Earlier runs used weighted sums, so complement or KL improvements could purchase target degradation. This test makes per-environment target matching a hard checkpoint-selection condition relative to DIM, then compares deterministic KL optimization with antithetic tangent-noise KL optimization. A complete construction family selects; v10/v11 remain sealed.

population.gradient: A1 and A2 even rows from temporal cue banks v1 and v2, four environments
population.selection: all jointly capable A1/A2 rows from complete-family bank v8, two environments
population.sealed: all jointly capable A1/A2 rows from fresh banks v10 and v11, four environments

rank_and_site: one 128-dimensional direction in complete L11H3 value-output coordinates

feasibility.rule: For every selection environment and each target term, checkpoint error must be no more than the corresponding DIM error plus 0.02. Infeasible checkpoints cannot win regardless of complement/KL score.
feasibility.training_barrier: 100 times squared positive violations of the same DIM+0.02 bounds; scientific selection still uses the exact hard rule

secondary_objective: Worst-environment sum of normalized margin complement, L15 complement, full-vocabulary complement, and full-vocabulary match losses

learned_arms.deterministic: DIM and pooled-aligned starts; 40 Adam steps; checkpoints every 10 steps
learned_arms.noise: same starts and schedule, with deterministic antithetic rank-one tangent perturbations of sigma 0.03 during fitting; unperturbed checkpoint evaluation

selection: Lexicographically select a feasible v8 checkpoint by lowest worst secondary objective, then mean objective, then fixed arm/start/step order. DIM is always eligible.

predictions.pred_a_authority_instrument_finiteness_a: All authorities, causal-hook closure, finite traces, complete populations, and registered price close.
predictions.pred_b_nonbaseline_feasible_checkpoint_e: At least one moved deterministic or noisy checkpoint is v8-feasible under both target readers in both panels.
predictions.pred_c_feasible_optimization_improves_v8: The selected non-DIM checkpoint lowers v8 worst secondary objective at least 5% versus DIM while satisfying every hard target constraint.
predictions.pred_d_selected_generalizes_to_sealed_fa: On every v10/v11 A1/A2 cell, both target errors remain within DIM+0.02, and sealed mean and worst secondary objectives are below DIM.
predictions.pred_e_regularization_is_stable_not_memo: The winning learned condition has absolute cosine at least 0.80 across its DIM and pooled starts, or the exact selector retains a frozen baseline rather than accepting an unstable update.

terminal_policy.family_memorization: B holds but C or D fails
terminal_policy.dim_frontier: no moved feasible checkpoint exists and DIM/frozen baseline wins

anti_rank_drift: This tests stable identification, held-out prediction, extraction, and selective complement manipulation at a fixed rank and site; it does not search rank or compression.
